text: Security is a crucial part of web development. When building a website, developers must protect both user data and the system itself. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts information sent between the browser and the server. Authentication is also important, as it makes sure only the right people can access certain areas. Another key practice is input validation, which checks what users type into forms to stop harmful code from getting in. Developers should also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, so they can prevent attacks before they happen. Good security needs attention at every stage of a project.
